work.position: PhD Candidate in Quantum Machine Learning for Data Streams
work.summary: QRU models for streaming time series, spectral/Fourier analysis, flood-risk forecasting, QAOA/CVaR allocation, and low-parameter NISQ experiments.
Semantic data contracts, forecasting evaluation, audit and provenance, XAI hooks, human-in-the-loop review, and reproducible Python/FastAPI-style prototypes.
Diagnostic design for natural-event regime shifts and pre-event signals, with an emphasis on reproducibility and interpretable outputs.
Cross-day/domain-shift analysis of multichannel EMG classifiers using attribution methods and explanation-stability diagnostics.
